g.text: T2: Goal [valid, new id] / Preempted(old), Accepted(new)
T4: Cancel · T6: override · T7: not_ready · T8: position stale
Each Cycle: events in arrival order (Pose, Goal, Cancel), then Supervise (T6, T7, T8, T9), then Advance (T10–T12), then one ExecOut.
Supervise and Advance are separate internal events: statig dispatches child first, so fault rules must not share an event with arrival.
Solid: command or Supervise rule. Dashed: Advance rule. Setpoint every cycle in S2, never in S1. T3, T5, T13 are internal.
